owner: blank-space-gauge. A layout is DATA: a new page shape is a new row here plus a control in controls.py, never a code branch. Thresholds exist only here (AP-22); the README and the calibration note name the row, never restate the value.

ink_rule.source: ink: same rule as post-format-lab harness/holes.py (a pixel more than 28 grey levels from the paper median; a cell under 0.4 % ink is empty). surface (added 2026-11-04): a pixel more than 6 grey levels from the paper is a fill (card, sheet, pale box, hatch, highlighter); a cell at least 25 % fill is occupied even without ink, because the inside of a drawn box is held space, not bare paper. Measured: sketch-deck paper std 0.85 grey levels, white card fill +8..+11, pale blue box -20, hatched bar 31-37 % of pixels past 6.

sketch-deck-169.what: AssetVault sketch-deck-169 production deck slide (1920x1080 card; title + subtitle band above, credit band below)
sketch-deck-169.review_when: the sketch-deck-169 card anatomy (title band, credit band) changes, a slide the author rejects scores under its threshold, or a published slide scores over it

card-45.what: post-format-lab sketch-post card (1080x1350; title above, takeaway pill below), the anatomy of harness/holes.py
card-45.review_when: a 4:5 card set is calibrated two-sided with this tool (holes.py stays the ruler for 4:5 until then)

unknown_policy.rule: an image whose ratio matches no layout (and no --layout given) is measured on a generic band (6 % margins all round, grid sized to about 144 near-square cells) and reported 'undetermined': numbers are printed, no look-at verdict is given and it is excluded from every count (AP-62)
